note: Eleven rows, and eleven is the whole of it: [A8 §9 item 8] records that every other fact class is uncovered. The subject family column is quoted from [SD §4.7], never re-derived here ([A8 §5] caveat i). Every row's authority is boundBy = CUSTODY unless the row says otherwise ([A8 §5] caveat iii), but the value is written out on every row rather than inherited, because an inherited default is the thing that goes wrong silently.
owedNote: Owed is a value, never an absence. A standing names role-enum members in 'roles' and every asserter designation that is NOT an enum member in 'unresolved', each carrying what it is owed to — usually [A8 §9 item 2] (the role vocabulary is undefined), sometimes [A8 §9 item 1] (there is no party entity), and in row 9's case not owed at all but COMPUTED by custodyAt. An empty standing is written as an empty standing with a note saying so; it never arrives as a missing key.
structuralObservation: [A8 §5]'s own closing paragraph: three of eleven rows have no authoritative role — weight.net and sitEntryDate are empty, condition is plural rather than empty. 'That is not a failure of the table. In each case a source supplies something BETTER than a role — a value rule, a mandatory derivation, or a joint record — and the table's job is to say so rather than to invent a winner.' [ORIGINAL] as an observation. Those are exactly the three rows carrying a 'settlement', which is [A8 §4.4] A8-NAMED holding: where authoritative is empty or plural, a tie-break rule MUST be named and 'a resolution may never fall back to latest wins implicitly'.
overlapNote: A role may appear in two standings on one row: [A8 §5 r1] has destinationAgent corroborating at its own end AND competing at destination. The loader does not forbid the overlap, because the document requires it.

Closing F3 removes a contradiction between two published sentences; it does not turn a synthesis into a citation.
